title: Adding a route under /broadcasts: literal paths before :id, and products.tsx mirrors manifest
answers: Why does /broadcasts/library open as 'Broadcast not found'?
How to add a new tab route under /broadcasts
Broadcasts tab URL resolves as a broadcast id
body:
kea-router matches routes in declaration order, so literal paths under /broadcasts must be listed BEFORE '/broadcasts/:id' or the segment resolves as a broadcast id.
Enforced in products/workflows/manifest.tsx (routes map: /broadcasts/library, channels, opt-outs, suppression, reputation, new, then :id).
frontend/src/products.tsx `productRoutes` and `productUrls` are generated from the manifest; regenerate rather than hand-edit.
products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastsRoutes.test.ts asserts each literal path resolves to the 'Broadcasts' scene and uuid/new to 'Broadcast'; extend it when adding routes.
Unknown segments like /broadcasts/bogus-tab still fall to :id and show 'Broadcast not found'.
applies: products/workflows routing for /broadcasts/* and any scene with a literal-vs-param route mix
